subtitle: Local print control
saved: Saved. Restart the app to apply port changes.
invalid_paper: Paper width and height must be between 0 and 2000 mm.
agent_listening_detail: Set a default printer and allow your website Origin before sending jobs.
agent_ready_detail: Your default printer, paper size, and website access are configured.
at_glance_detail: The local listener accepts jobs and submits them to the system print queue.
data_location_detail: Configuration and job history belong to this app only.
default_print_setup_detail: New jobs use these values when the client does not specify them.
test_print_submitted: Test page submitted to the system queue. Check the physical output.
test_remote_ok: Remote GET and POST test requests succeeded.
recent_logs_detail: Latest in-memory agent events; secrets are redacted.
available_printers_detail: Use the system printer name exactly as shown below.
no_printers: No printers found. Check the system printer service and refresh the device list.
website_access_detail: Add one exact website Origin per line. Empty means browsers cannot connect.
client_access_detail: Local IPs are allowed by default. Add IP addresses or CIDR ranges only when needed.
restart_port: Port changes take effect after restarting the app.
remote_polling_detail: Fetch jobs from your HTTPS endpoint using this device's credentials.
token_detail: The token is hidden on screen and saved in this app's configuration.
recent_jobs_detail: The latest 50 status events stored on this device.
no_jobs: No jobs yet. Accepted print jobs will appear here.
system_checks_detail: Check configuration and local dependencies without printing or contacting the remote server.
run_checks_prompt: Run checks to see printer, renderer and configuration readiness.
settings_detail: Choose the language used by the desktop app. The selection is saved immediately.
language_note: Technical details keep the original text returned by the operating system.
setup_heading: Set up your first print job
setup_intro: Choose a printer, paper size, and the website allowed to connect. Nothing is printed during setup.
setup_printer_detail: Select an installed printer for jobs that do not name one.
setup_paper_detail: Enter a size supported by the selected printer. Check its capabilities if unsure.
setup_origin_detail: Enter the exact http:// or https:// Origin of your business website, one per line.
setup_connection_detail: The app uses its own data directory and listens on the port below.
setup_port_conflict_hint: If another program owns this port, choose a free port, finish setup, and restart this app. The other program will not be stopped.
setup_done: Setup saved. You can now send print jobs.
setup_done_restart: Setup saved. Restart the app to apply the new port.
setup_skipped: Setup skipped. Open the guide from Settings when ready.
setup_select_printer_error: Choose an installed printer before continuing.
setup_origin_error: Add at least one website Origin before continuing.
setup_invalid_config: Check the setup values and try again.
error_port_in_use: The local port is already in use. Choose another port and restart the app.
error_printer_not_found: The selected printer is not installed.
error_paper_not_configured: Set a default paper size first.
error_paper_not_found: The printer does not advertise that paper size.
error_permission: The app does not have permission for this action.
error_printer_backend: The system printer service returned an error.
error_agent_not_running: The local agent is not running.
error_conflict: The requested resource is already in use.
error_doctor: One or more system checks failed.
error_generic: The operation failed. See the technical detail below.
doctor_detail_port_busy: Port %d is already in use. Choose a free port and restart the app.
doctor_detail_port_ok: Port %d is available to this app.
doctor_detail_no_printers: No printers were found. Check the system printer service.
doctor_detail_printer_missing_default: %d printer(s) found; no default printer is configured.
doctor_detail_no_paper: No default paper size is configured.
doctor_detail_no_origins: No website Origin is allowed; browser clients cannot connect.
doctor_detail_no_ips: No client IP is allowed; connections will be rejected.
doctor_detail_remote_missing_url: Remote polling is enabled without an endpoint.
doctor_detail_no_retention: No history retention period is configured.
doctor_detail_agent_off: The agent is not running; only offline checks were performed.
doctor_detail_agent_jobs: %d job(s) are waiting or running in the agent.
doctor_detail_raw: Check the system component. Technical detail: %s
config_transfer_detail: Move settings between machines with an encrypted file.
config_transfer_note: Exports are encrypted with Argon2id + AES-256-GCM. Only the selected fields are written, so importing a selective export leaves every other setting untouched.
export_body: Choose the fields to include, then pick where to save the encrypted file.
export_password_hint: Leave empty to export without a password. The file stays encrypted, but anyone can open it.
export_empty_password_warning: The remote token is selected while the password is empty. The file can be opened by anyone who obtains it.
export_empty_password_confirm: I understand and want to export anyway
export_no_fields: Select at least one field to export.
import_body: Choose an exported file and its password. You will see the changes before anything is applied.
import_password_hint: The password used when the file was exported.
no_import_changes: This file matches the current configuration.
import_failed: The file could not be opened: wrong password or damaged file.
task_details_detail: Select a job to see its status timeline.
select_task_hint: Select a row in the table above.
no_status_records: No status records for this job.
clear_history_body: Finished jobs and their status events are deleted. Jobs still queued or printing are kept.
remote_identity_detail: How the business server recognises this installation.
device_id_generated: A new device ID was generated. Save to apply it.
remote_limits_hint: The poll interval is at least 3 seconds and retries at least 1.
remote_test_detail: Send a test GET and POST to the saved endpoint without touching real jobs.
invalid_remote_interval: The poll interval must be a whole number of at least 3 seconds.
invalid_remote_retries: The report retry count must be a whole number of at least 1.
loopback_pinned: The loopback address cannot be removed: the desktop UI and CLI connect over it.
entry_duplicate: This entry is already in the list.
invalid_origin: Enter an Origin such as https://example.com — scheme and host only, no path or query.
invalid_ip: Enter an IP address or CIDR block, for example 192.168.1.0/24.
invalid_any_ip: An any-address entry (0.0.0.0/0, ::/0) would open the agent to the whole network.
no_origins: No website Origin is allowed yet; browser clients cannot connect.
no_ips: No client IP is allowed yet; connections will be rejected.
listener_detail: The port business systems connect to.
no_logs: No log entries loaded. Press Refresh logs.
hint_config: Fix config.json, then run `print-bridge config validate`.
hint_data_dir: Grant the running user write access to the data directory.
hint_port: Choose a free port and restart the app.
hint_printers: Check the system print service and permissions, then install a printer.
hint_paper: Set valid paper dimensions with `print-bridge paper set`.
hint_origins: Add the business website Origin so browser clients can connect.
hint_ips: Add at least the loopback address so local clients can connect.
hint_renderer: Install Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome or Chromium for HTML jobs.
hint_remote: Configure the URL, token and device ID, or turn remote polling off.
hint_retention: Set a history retention period so history does not grow without bound.
no_printers_hint: No printers were detected. You can still type a queue name.
default_copies_hint: Used when a job does not specify copies.
invalid_copies: The default copy count must be a whole number of at least 1.
appearance_detail: Language and visual theme of the desktop app.
theme_note: The theme applies immediately and is saved.
about_detail: Version and build information for this installation.
updates_detail: PrintBridge checks the GitHub releases for signed updates and installs them on request.
updates_unavailable: This build cannot check for updates. Updates come with the installer.
about_links_detail: This program is distributed under the Apache-2.0 license.
about_license_note: Bundled third-party components are listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
about_diagnostics_detail: Copy a redacted summary for support. Secrets are never included.
dead_letters_detail: Status reports that never reached the business server. Retry them once the server is reachable, or discard them if the event is obsolete.
no_dead_letters: No abandoned status reports. Every report reached the server.
purge_dead_letters_body: These status reports will be deleted permanently. The business server will never learn them. Jobs whose status was lost stay recorded in history.
export_history_body: Write the jobs matching the current filter to a file.
export_history_empty: No jobs match the current filter; nothing was written.
printer_required: Select a printer before printing a test page.
